outcome.answer: Yes—[1] is a direct match for Bangla spoken regional speech data because it presents a regional corpus of Bengali spontaneous speech across dialects and says the released dataset is for public use. [3] is also closely related because it builds a real-time speech assistance system for Bengali regional dialects and uses a dialect-aware ASR system evaluated on [1]. [4], [8], and [6] are related to Bangla speech processing, but they focus on long-form ASR, speaker diarization, or end-of-turn detection rather than regional speech data specifically.
